summary: Backend-only verification of expense pagination fix in /app/backend/routes/expenses_new.py. Created pytest suite (8 tests) covering: variable-expense default 90-day filter, explicit from_date/to_date override, 2000-item limit smoke test, seeded old-record exclusion by default filter, newly-created today-dated expense visibility, fixed-expense default current-month/year filter, explicit month/year override, and fixed-expense limit smoke. All 8 tests PASS against the preview URL as admin@freshflow.com.
action_items: Consider removing the orphan/duplicate file /app/backend/routes/expenses.py (still contains the OLD 500-cap variable/fixed expenses handlers with no default date filter). It is not currently registered (only expenses_new is imported in routes/__init__.py), but leaving it in the tree is confusing and risks regressions if someone re-wires it.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate stale module: /app/backend/routes/expenses.py has GET /expenses/variable with to_list(500) and no default filter; not imported but should be deleted or clearly marked deprecated.

get_variable_expenses default branch: when from_date/to_date are both absent, the to_date upper-bound isn't set. This is fine functionally, but the to_date-only branch mutates query['date'] as a str (query['date'] = {'$lte': ...}) which is OK; consider unifying the query builder for readability.

Fixed expenses default uses now.month/now.year based on UTC. If business operates in IST (UTC+5:30), around month boundaries this could show the wrong month for a few hours. Consider using the app's configured timezone.
seed_data_creation: Tests transiently insert and delete TEST_-prefixed variable expenses (today-dated and 200-days-old); cleaned up in finally blocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DB currently has 500 variable_expenses all dated 2026-05-15..2026-08-04 (verified via direct Mongo count). Wide-range vs default-90d return identical counts because all data is within last 90 days; the 2000 limit path cannot be data-exercised without seeding >500 rows. Fixed expenses collection is empty for 8/2026 in preview DB.
rca of the issue: Original bug: GET /api/expenses/variable used to_list(500) with no default date filter, so once 500 records existed, adding a new record pushed oldest off the list. Fix applied by main agent in expenses_new.py: default 90-day date filter when no from/to_date given and limit raised to 2000; fixed expenses defaults to current month/year with 2000 limit. Verified behavior end-to-end via API tests.
